title: Bitcoin listless, Nvidia perps crash 7% as CEO Jensen Huang reportedly faces the axe
summary: Nvidia perps are down 7% on Hyperliquid as traders react to reports that CEO Jensen Huang may be removed. Bitcoin continues to trade in a familiar price range.

title: Crypto Long & Short: The GENIUS Act’s guarantees don’t cover DeFi lending
summary: Institutions weighing DeFi lending tend to ask which markets are safest. Mike Hathaway and Joseph Quintilian of Ajna argue the better question is who can change a loan’s terms after the money is lent, and why a fully backed stablecoin offers no protection against a token vote or a faulty price feed.

title: OKXICE to debut tokenized stock trading with Strategy, Coinbase, Circle this month
summary: After initial issuer pushback, the blockchain venue is set to start trading on Nov. 23 and said will list over 70 assets, including Strategy’s common and preferred shares and 59 of Direxion's ETFs.

title: Meet Spiko, the largest tokenized fund in the world you’ve probably never heard about
summary: The firm’s flagship Spiko Amundi Overnight Swap Fund (SAFO) held $2.39 billion in assets under management as of late last month.

title: Live news: Bitcoin remains under pressure as CoreWeave, Nvidia lead AI rebound
summary: The DRAM ETF jumps 8% and semiconductor stocks gain more than 4%, while bitcoin continues to test its 200-day moving average.
